M.A.R.S. Companion LLC

M.A.R.S. Companion LLC is a technology company developing M.A.R.S. Companion, a fully offline AI voice companion with long-term semantic memory.

The company's focus is private, locally processed artificial intelligence that operates on user-controlled hardware rather than relying on cloud AI infrastructure.

Company

Name:
M.A.R.S. Companion LLC

Industry:
Artificial Intelligence, Local AI, Privacy Technology, Consumer Hardware

M.A.R.S. Companion

https://teduza.com/

https://company.teduza.com/

Mission

M.A.R.S. Companion LLC aims to develop personal AI systems that belong to the user and keep their conversations, memories, and data under the user's control.

The company's product philosophy is privacy by design: AI should be capable of operating locally without requiring continuous cloud connectivity or sending personal conversations to third-party servers.

Product

M.A.R.S. Companion is a Mobile Autonomous Reasoning System and fully offline AI voice companion.

The product is designed around:

- Local AI inference
- Offline operation
- Long-term semantic memory
- Context-aware reasoning
- Voice interaction
- Private personal data storage
- No cloud dependency
- No mandatory subscriptions
- No mandatory user account

Technology

The system uses a custom execution architecture called Sequential Resource Orchestration.

This architecture dynamically manages computationally intensive AI components in sequence, allowing the system to perform complex AI tasks and memory retrieval on relatively constrained hardware.

A working prototype has been demonstrated on Raspberry Pi 4 with 4 GB RAM.

Privacy Architecture

M.A.R.S. Companion is designed around local processing.

The intended architecture keeps conversations, memories, and AI processing on the user's device.

The system also incorporates hardware-level data protection using device-specific encryption keys. Unauthorized access to protected storage is designed to prevent the stored data from being read.

Prototype

The company has developed a functional prototype capable of performing an offline AI pipeline consisting of:

- Speech-to-text
- Semantic memory retrieval
- Context-aware reasoning
- Speech synthesis

The prototype has been tested by the founder and additional users.

Intellectual Property

M.A.R.S. Companion has pending UK patent applications.

The product website publicly identifies GB2611463.7 and a priority date of 15 May 2026.

The company has stated that six UK patent applications were filed with priority dates secured.

Company Status

M.A.R.S. Companion LLC was officially registered on 17 August 2026.

The company is currently developing the next prototype stage, including component sourcing and hardware refinement.

The planned roadmap includes closed beta testing and a limited hardware release.

Founder

Aleksandr Sarkisian is the inventor and founder of M.A.R.S. Companion.

Collaboration

M.A.R.S. Companion LLC is open to:

- Technical discussions
- Academic feedback
- Research collaboration
- Engineering collaboration
- AI and hardware partnerships
- Product development opportunities
